description_target.target_text: 30x30 grid with small colored shapes. Some cells get recolored (color→color, not from black). ~64-81 cells change per pair. Recoloring targets corners or boundary cells of shapes — marker-based recolor where the new color depends on the spatial context of surrounding colored neighbors.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; Two-color 5x5 motifs (majority BODY + one odd CORE cell; loose satellite dots join the
  ;; motif whose 5x5 box they share). Output = per-motif color swap: body cells -> core color,
  ;; the core cell -> body color. A motif whose core is OFF-center inherits the body color of a
  ;; CONGRUENT same-core twin whose core IS centered (twin motifs share one color-pair identity).
  ;; Each non-bg CORNER pixel is a marker: every motif whose core matches the marker color is
  ;; stamped at that corner (its own bbox flush inward, marker-colored) — except a motif that
  ;; fully ENCLOSES background stamps only its hole-bounding loop (appendages drop).
  (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))
         (bg (mode g -1))                        ;; modal color = background (never assume 0)
         (corner-ps (list (list 0 0) (list 0 (- w 1)) (list (- h 1) 0) (list (- h 1) (- w 1))))
         (markers (filter (lambda (p) (!= (at g (first p) (second p)) bg)) corner-ps))
         (g-noc (reduce (lambda (acc p) (set-cell acc (first p) (second p) bg)) g markers))
         (as-rc (lambda (p) (if (pair? (cdr p)) p (list (car p) (cdr p))))))
    (define (fits5? cells)                       ;; union still fits one 5x5 motif box?
      (let* ((b (bbox-of-cells cells)))
        (and (< (- (third b) (first b)) 5) (< (- (fourth b) (second b)) 5))))
    (define (merge-pass gs)                      ;; merge FIRST mergeable pair -> (list did? gs)
      (if (null? gs) (list #f '())
          (let* ((a (first gs))
                 (partner (findf (lambda (o) (fits5? (append a o))) (rest gs))))
            (if partner
                (list #t (cons (append a partner) (remove partner (rest gs))))
                (let ((sub (merge-pass (rest gs))))
                  (list (first sub) (cons a (second sub))))))))
    (define (merge-motifs gs)                    ;; ... to fixpoint (satellite dots -> their motif)
      (let* ((p (merge-pass gs)))
        (if (first p) (merge-motifs (second p)) (second p))))
    ;; motif = (cells body-color core-color core-cell bbox centered?)
    (define (motif-of cells)
      (let* ((cnt (for/fold ((hsh (hash))) ((p cells))
                    (let* ((v (at g (first p) (second p))))
                      (hash-set hsh v (add1 (hash-ref hsh v 0))))))
             (ks (sort (hash-keys cnt) (lambda (a b) (> (hash-ref cnt a) (hash-ref cnt b))))))
        (if (< (length ks) 2) #f                 ;; single-color blob: not a motif, leave alone
            (let* ((body (first ks)) (core (last ks))
                   (cc (findf (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) core)) cells))
                   (b (bbox-of-cells cells))
                   (ctr (list (quotient (+ (first b) (third b)) 2)
                              (quotient (+ (second b) (fourth b)) 2))))
              (list cells body core cc b (equal? cc ctr))))))
    (define (m-cells m) (first m))
    (define (m-body m) (second m))
    (define (m-core m) (third m))
    (define (m-bbox m) (fifth m))
    (define (m-centered? m) (sixth m))
    (define motifs
      (filter (lambda (m) m)
              (map motif-of (merge-motifs (map (lambda (o) (map as-rc (obj-cells o)))
                                               (objects-8 g-noc bg))))))
    (define (core-target m)                      ;; centered-cored twin defines the pair identity
      (let* ((twin (and (not (m-centered? m))
                       (findf (lambda (o) (and (not (eq? o m))
                                               (= (m-core o) (m-core m))
                                               (m-centered? o)
                                               (member (normalize-cells (m-cells m))
                                                       (all-transforms (m-cells o))
                                                       cells-equal?)))
                              motifs))))
        (if twin (m-body twin) (m-body m))))
    (define (hole-cells m)                       ;; bg inside bbox not 8-reachable from its border
      (let* ((b (m-bbox m)) (r1 (first b)) (c1 (second b)) (r2 (third b)) (c2 (fourth b))
             (own (list->set (m-cells m)))
             (inb? (lambda (p) (and (<= r1 (first p) r2) (<= c1 (second p) c2))))
             (seed (filter (lambda (p) (not (set-member? own p)))
                           (for*/list ((y (range r1 (+ r2 1))) (x (range c1 (+ c2 1)))
                                       #:when (or (= y r1) (= y r2) (= x c1) (= x c2)))
                             (list y x)))))
        (let loop ((frontier seed) (vis (list->set seed)))
          (if (null? frontier)
              (for*/list ((y (range r1 (+ r2 1))) (x (range c1 (+ c2 1)))
                          #:when (and (not (set-member? own (list y x)))
                                      (not (set-member? vis (list y x)))))
                (list y x))
              (let* ((p (first frontier))
                     (nbrs (filter (lambda (q) (and (inb? q) (not (set-member? own q))
                                                    (not (set-member? vis q))))
                                   (for*/list ((dy '(-1 0 1)) (dx '(-1 0 1))
                                               #:when (not (and (zero? dy) (zero? dx))))
                                     (list (+ (first p) dy) (+ (second p) dx))))))
                (loop (append (rest frontier) nbrs)
                      (for/fold ((v vis)) ((q nbrs)) (set-add v q))))))))
    (define (stamp-cells m)                      ;; enclosing motif -> only its hole-bounding loop
      (let* ((holes (hole-cells m)))
        (if (null? holes) (m-cells m)
            (filter (lambda (p) (findf (lambda (hh) (and (<= (abs (- (first p) (first hh))) 1)
                                                         (<= (abs (- (second p) (second hh))) 1)))
                                       holes))
                    (m-cells m)))))
    (define swapped
      (for/fold ((acc g)) ((m motifs))
        (let* ((tgt (core-target m)))
          (for/fold ((a2 acc)) ((p (m-cells m)))
            (set-cell a2 (first p) (second p)
                      (if (= (at g (first p) (second p)) (m-body m)) (m-core m) tgt))))))
    (for/fold ((acc swapped)) ((mk markers))
      (let* ((mr (first mk)) (mc (second mk)) (mcol (at g (first mk) (second mk))))
        (for/fold ((a2 acc)) ((m motifs))
          (if (!= (m-core m) mcol) a2
              (let* ((b (m-bbox m))
                     (bh (+ 1 (- (third b) (first b)))) (bw (+ 1 (- (fourth b) (second b))))
                     (br (if (zero? mr) 0 (- h bh))) (bc (if (zero? mc) 0 (- w bw))))
                (for/fold ((a3 a2)) ((p (stamp-cells m)))
                  (set-cell a3 (+ br (- (first p) (first b)))
                            (+ bc (- (second p) (second b))) mcol))))))))))
